svg.title: GTFS Planner — G14D.3B
svg.desc: Navy outlined GTFS Planner lettering beside a teal transit route with two station rings and a pink dot inside the first station. Short continuing route extensions. Reconstructed from the approved concept with exact route geometry and flattened brand colors: navy #0A1330, teal #3FA8A8, pink #EE2A7B. Background and station openings are transparent. No external fonts or embedded raster images.
